premises.text: Online/retail furniture shopping is high risk because homeowners cannot see how items will look in their own homes, and existing 3D tools are too hard, expensive, or slow for homeowners
Inside Maps lets anyone create a 3D model of their home with a smartphone by capturing wall photos plus gyro/accelerometer/magnetometer data
premises.evidence_span: the only homeowner-friendly solution that allows anyone to create a 3D model of their own home with just a smartphone

premises.text: Homeowners place catalog and personal furniture in the model, measure fit, use designer boards/collections, and collaborate via browser links and sticky notes
premises.evidence_span: She opens a link to her model and takes a sofa from the Crate and Barrel catalog and puts it in her living room

premises.text: Cloud GPU algorithms turn multi-image captures into point clouds, detect structure, and render photorealistic WebGL models in minutes
premises.evidence_span: we're able to do this in a few minutes using GPU compute power on the cloud

premises.text: Business model connects retailers to homeowners so retailers upsell, reach new customers, and lower returns
premises.evidence_span: Our business opportunity is to connect retailers with homeowners

domains.name: high-risk furniture shopping without home context

value.text: Homeowners shop furniture with confidence by seeing items photorealistically in their own rooms; home becomes the showroom
value.evidence_span: your home becomes the ultimate showroom, that your home becomes the ideal place to shop for furniture

secondary_value.text: Retailers make more money via upsell, new customers, and lower returns
secondary_value.evidence_span: our experience will make them more money, It will help them upsell to new accessories. It will also help them reach new customers, and it will lower their returns

causal_links.evidence_span: It's just hard to see how something that you choose online or even in a retail store will look in your own home
By working with retailers and connecting them to homeowners and providing the ideal shopping experience for homeowners, we will revolutionize the $50 billion furniture market

notes: Fit uncertainty and hard/expensive/slow 3D tools folded as one homeowner problem set (§4.1.6). Capture sensors, staging/collaboration UI, and cloud reconstruction/photorealism folded as cascade/packages of one homeowner 3D platform (§4.1.7–8).
